name: code-review
description: Collect the pending diff, review it, scan the touched files for secrets, summarise findings and gate the merge.

steps.description: Collect the staged, unstaged and branch diff against the base ref.
Review the diff for correctness, regressions and missing tests.
Scan the collected diff and touched files for credentials, independently of the review.
Write the review report: merge verdict, or the required-changes list when blockers remain.
Confirm the merge conclusion only when the diff review passed.
